purpose: Re-evaluate Dual Masenko as a potential canonical-skill omission and PQ118 cross-domain endpoint.

evidence.finding: Dual Masenko is classified as a Ki Blast Super, costs 100 Ki, and is obtainable from the TP Medal Shop; Future Trunks is a notable user.

Dragon Ball Wiki identifies Dual Masenko as a Xenoverse 2 Super Skill for Future Trunks and says the Future Warrior can obtain it from the TP Medal Shop; it is also available in Future Trunks' Customize Partner skillset.
Historical TP Medal Shop schedule documents Dual Masenko at 170 TP Medals in the June/July 2017 rotation.
Historical update schedule independently identifies Dual Masenko as a Ki Blast Skill sold for 170 TP Medals.
Later community TP Medal Shop rotation lists Dual Masenko as a 170-TP Ki Blast Super.

repository_findings: docs/data/skill-research-batches/skill-batch-261.json already records Dual Masenko as a 100-Ki Super obtainable through Future Trunks training, but that acquisition statement conflicts with the stronger TP Medal Shop evidence and should not be treated as canonical acquisition truth.

docs/data/partner-custom-skill-domain-boundary-audit-2026-09-26.json explicitly documents Dual Masenko as a canonical Xenoverse 2 Super Skill obtainable by the Future Warrior and available in Future Trunks' Customize Partner skillset.
docs/data/partner-skill-relationships.json currently excludes Dual Masenko only because the canonical skill-dual-masenko record is absent.
docs/data/pq-unrepresented-skill-endpoint-evidence-reconciliation-2026-09-26.json lists PQ118 as unresolved because Dual Masenko lacked a canonical record.
decision: Dual Masenko is sufficiently evidenced as a genuine canonical CaC skill and is not merely a partner-only skill. The repository therefore has a likely canonical omission. Do not invent a PQ118 edge yet: current evidence is conflicting about PQ118 and the strongest direct acquisition evidence is TP Medal Shop. Canonical record restoration should be performed only after safely obtaining/editing the complete canonical skills.json and skills-index.json layers.
next_actions: Restore/add skill-dual-masenko to canonical skills.json and skills-index.json using the existing canonical schema.
Use TP Medal Shop as the documented acquisition route; do not inherit the stale 'Training with Future Trunks' field from Batch 261.
Then re-run partner/custom relationship census and PQ118 reconciliation; only add PQ118 Skill→PQ if explicit skill-reward evidence survives source reconciliation.

prepared_canonical_record.name: Dual Masenko
prepared_canonical_record.effect: Spin in a semicircle while firing Ki Waves from both hands; effective at close range.

post_restoration_note: The historical gap finding is now resolved: the live canonical and index layers contain skill-dual-masenko within the post-recovery 493-record corpus. Partner Customization relationship for Future Trunks (Time Patrol) was restored. PQ118 remains unresolved and no Skill→PQ edge was manufactured. Direct PQ118 research was rechecked: the repository's PQ118 record/Steam guide list other rewards and do not list Dual Masenko; a separate current web guide claims Dual Masenko for a differently titled PQ118, so no PQ118 edge was added. The restored canonical record's unsupported 'Free Update 4' DLC requirement was removed and set to null.
